_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (score ±2 in ~3% of windows) plus 9/9 HOLD record and no phase-breaker factors keep the rung fixed inside 39-46.
next_move.brains_agree: yes on current Anxiety phase; narrative silent on forward direction so analyst HOLD-phase / SHORT-price stands
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed stays 25-40 and btc_momentum_30d ~40-55 with etf_flows still pinned, score inside 39-46
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks under 20 on fast leg down (toward Denial) or etf_flows+momentum re-accelerate together (toward Complacency); price SHORT dies on reclaim of ~80.1k
